title.zh: 跨产品白名单模板删除接口

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口用于删除[CreateCloudBenchTasks](~~230665~~)接口创建的智能压测任务中已释放的DBgateway元数据。
- 在使用SDK调用DAS服务时，需要将地域指定为cn-shanghai。

> 当DBGateway与接入点超过20秒无心跳时，此DBGateway为停止状态。
descriptions.en:
- This operation deletes the metadata of released database gateways from intelligent stress testing tasks created by the [CreateCloudBenchTasks](~~230665~~) operation.

- When you use an SDK to call the DAS service, set the region to cn-shanghai.

> A database gateway is considered stopped if there is no heartbeat between it and an endpoint for more than 20 seconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun das delete-security-ip-group --region-name cn-shanghai --global-security-group-id g-rcge12hbfooad3m0000 --region cn-hangzhou
